verdict.rationale: First-party Workspace docs list voicemail-to-text transcription as a core Voice feature. Hands-on community users confirm the transcriptions are emailed to their inbox, calling this the 'killer feature', though one notes they still need the app when transcription fails. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of email delivery, any evidence of delivery to chat apps, and documentation of how accurate or reliable transcription is.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in

citations.quote: Çalışanlar, akıllı spam arama koruması ve sesli mesajı metne dönüştürme özellikleri ile herhangi bir cihazdan kullanabilecekleri bir telefon numarası alır.
The killer feature keeping this user on Google Voice is voicemail transcription emailed to their inbox.
